reasoning_details.text:
Comparing the two drafts, A drops the "Oak Street" name and the "Please" politeness marker but keeps the carrier attribution, while B preserves the street name but loses some of the "carrier says" framing even though "due" softens the certainty somewhat, and I'm checking how each handles the tracking number line against the original draft's phrasing.

The name omission in A feels like a harder rule violation since names should always be preserved, whereas B's issues are more about attribution and tone shifts plus a less polite "you will need to" phrasing. Weighing both sets of defects, I'm leaning toward B as the better choice, though it's close.
